sizing.rule: owner 10-10: bandwidth must not be the bottleneck, no fixed % of peak
sizing.decision: prefetch one row ahead into a 2-row VM buffer (163,840 B): the window is the scheduled HC start-to-start gap (min 3,440.5 cycles). On demand the row would have to arrive inside the G22 row compute (48.3 of the 1,353.8-cycle record: 1,696 B/cycle = 53 sectors/cycle, above the loader front and the VM wide write); prefetch removes it from the critical path

kport_existing.what: the loader native port that already reaches every stack (ot_hfd_loader_kport, bursts + multi-outstanding, d8b1b836c): HC rows striped over the 4 stacks, prefetched one row ahead by DMA.LOAD into the VM double buffer
kport_existing.note: RB 64 a stack doubles the in-flight window (rate ~ RB x 32 / RTT): ~2x margin; no svc segment change, no new die nets. Needs the DMA mover (kport lane 2) on the native burst + multi-outstanding protocol the CP fetch lane already uses (budget audit hbm_dma_load: the mover is one sector a round trip today) -> hgi-1010 DMA owner

dma_v2_nl8.what: svc DMA stream v2, one lane per svc group (8 a stack, group-local 4:1 merge)
dma_v2_nl8.cost: all 17 svc segments re-route with --dma; die nets 8 x 270 + 51 + 8 b a stack

sizing.recommendation: HC prefetch needs <= 0.74 sectors/cycle a die; the existing kport path (4 stacks, RB >= 32, better 64) covers it with no svc re-close. DMA v2 is not required for HC.
